name: dsh-retrace
description: Retrace · 回溯 — Recall, edit-and-resend, regenerate, and conversation/artifact versioning (timeline, rollback, fork map) for DeepSeek Harness — Web and Desktop. This build is patched to run on DSH 0.2.x / Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2 (session format v4) with a vendored, v4-correct dsh-log-contract.

dshDesktopPatch.target: DSH 0.2.x (verified on DSH Desktop 0.2.0-rc.2, session format v4); v0–v3 behaviour unchanged
changes: official 5-type surface set (system/developer/user/assistant/tool) in all five copies
system/developer message text + role in the boundary digest
dsh-log-contract vendored in-package and made version-aware (v3/v4) — no pnpm override needed
dshDesktopPatch.vendoredDependency: vendor/dsh-log-contract (upstream 0.3.17 + v4 fixes, versioned 0.3.18), imported through lib/vendor-contract.js

scripts.check: node --check lib/index.js && node --check lib/vendor-contract.js && node --check lib/prewrite-guard.js && node --check lib/watchdog.js && node --check lib/versioning.js && node --check lib/archaeology-cli.js && node --check vendor/dsh-log-contract/lib/index.js && node --check bin/retrace.mjs

author: OfferKuai <contact@offerkuai.com> (https://www.offerkuai.com)
contributors: dsh-retrace-desktop build: local patch for DSH 0.2.x / session format v4 (see PATCH-NOTES.md)
